description: June 21 birthday meaning: Gemini or Cancer cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, June 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: June 21 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Around the solstice, June 21st usually holds the last degree of Gemini, though depending on birth year and time some people born today are Cancers instead. The blend tends to pair conversational sparkle with emotional memory. With birthday number 3, the gift is often storytelling, especially stories about family, home and where people come from.

On June 21 the Sun usually sits at about 29° Gemini, in the third decan, where Uranus is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. Birthdays around June 20 to June 22 fall on the Gemini–Cancer cusp, which also lines up with the June solstice. Gemini's curiosity and talk meet Cancer's feeling and attachment to home. Whether the Sun had already entered Cancer at your birth depends on the year, the hour and the place, since the boundary shifts by up to a day across years; a natal chart answers that precisely. People who identify with both signs are often described as emotionally articulate, able to name what they feel and to listen closely, with a busy mind and a heart that stays near family.

sections.heading: June 21 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 21 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on June 21: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 21 is the 172nd day of the year (173rd in a leap year). By June 22, 1 day later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 21 include Jean-Paul Sartre (1905), Lana Del Rey (1985) and Benazir Bhutto (1953).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 21?
faq.answer: June 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Gemini. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 21 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 21?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 21?
faq.answer: June 21 is also the birthday of Jean-Paul Sartre (1905), Lana Del Rey (1985) and Benazir Bhutto (1953). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
